title: Priced operation
description: One operation of a route, as the router prices it: the typed operation (#/$defs/operation) at one provider, with the amounts evaluated at the actual amount after the fees before it (REQ-QTE-12) and the figures it was evaluated with. That a withdrawal, route or deposit keeps its asset, that a route's nodes differ, that an exchange stays at one node and that the fee is in from's asset and at most the amount in are checked by the contract's Rust types.

provider.description: The provider the operation runs at.

fee.description: The provider's fee, in from's asset and unit, out of amount_in.

figures.description: The snapshot figures the operation was evaluated with, by id, each once (REQ-QTE-4): one tuple, of its own provider with its two ends, and one price for it; any fresh quote, dry run (for the operation's amount in) or judgement it cites names that tuple; and, when it names calls, the one calls figure of its own module release. Checked by the contract's Rust types.

calls.description: The cross-module calls this segment makes, each once (REQ-MDL-21): each declared by its provider's module, in the one calls figure the operation cites, of the release its tuple comes from, to the provider of another operation of the same part, and none to its own provider. Absent when it names none. Checked by the contract's Rust types.

kind.description: The kind of a typed operation: withdrawal, route, exchange or deposit, and no other; another needs a protocol change (REQ-ORD-37, REQ-PRT-5).

operation.description: The typed operation of REQ-ORD-37, which this contract owns (ruled by the orchestrator, 2026-11-06): its kind and its two ends, each a provider-role node and denomination. A withdrawal goes from an outer node into an inner one and a deposit the other way; a route and an exchange run at inner nodes. Open, so that a schema embedding it, such as the state machine's segment plan, adds its own fields and closes it with unevaluatedProperties: false.

from.description: Where the value starts, in that unit.

to.description: Where the value ends, in that unit.
